primary_title: Gfap and Osmr regulation by BRG1 and STAT3 via interchromosomal gene clustering in astrocytes
decision_basis: The review cites primary evidence that STAT3 and BRG1 co-occupy the Gfap regulatory region during LIF-induced astrocyte differentiation and that disruption of JAK-STAT or BRG1 reduces Gfap transcription.
limitations_preserved: STAT3/BRG1 co-occupancy plus perturbation-supported loss of clustering and Gfap expression support a bounded cooperative gene-activation edge; preserve LIF-induced astrocyte differentiation, chromatin-clustering and mouse precursor context, and do not infer GFAP protein abundance or reactive gliosis in every state automatically.
